---
title: Code windows
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: terminal
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The terminal Typst code windows keep the traffic lights and take the terminal frame and title bar from the tokens, with no warning and a PDF/UA-1 PDF.
        check: bash _checks/pdf.sh code-window terminal
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#code-window\(filename: "analysis\.R", is-auto: false, style: "macos"', 'show: mc-code-windows\.with\(meta\)']
---
